{{Quote|Frost buildup has damaged my transmission module, but internal repair mechanisms will return it to red octagon in a few dozen local system revolutions. Until then, deliver respectful regards!|Gamrokodavi-K|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Gamrokodavi-K''' was a [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] research [[Droid/Legends|droid]] dispatched by the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Gray Secant]]'' to study the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. It was accompanied by a squad of more heavily-armed Gree droids, and during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] it stopped transmitting because of frost buildup on its transmission module until its repair systems repaired it, a process that took several dozen years.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
